entries.dialogueText: Hugo smiled weakly.

entries.dialogueText: Hugo shot him a look of admonishment.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras

entries.dialogueText: "All right. Let's talk about the elephant in the room."

entries.dialogueText: Hugo exhaled.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""The whole of Valenqiris is still i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The whole of Valenqiris is still in an uproar after your decriminalization of homosexuality. And now, the news that you yourself are... are..."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""It took months to calm the uproar..."
entries.dialogueText: "It took months to calm the uproar that your decriminalization of homosexuality caused in Valenqiris. And now, the news that you yourself are... are..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There are more pressing matters th..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are more pressing matters than my personal life, gentlemen. We've got to deal with these protests."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Your Majesty, have you entertained..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, have you entertained the idea that the protests and your personal life may be connected?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All positive societal changes are..."
entries.dialogueText: "All positive societal changes are met with resistance at first. In time, relationships like mine will be considered completely normal, and bigots like you the anomaly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By changing that law, I freed thou..."
entries.dialogueText: "By changing that law, I freed thousands from having to live in fear. Myself included."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough with the melodrama, Hubertu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough with the melodrama, Hubertus. For all I know, this is just a phase."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go on, say it. Queer. Degenerate...."
entries.dialogueText: "Go on, say it. Queer. Degenerate. Light in the loafers."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle spoke without looking me i..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle spoke without looking me in the eye.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""And the news of a new Toras heir?..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the news of a new Toras heir? The icing on the proverbial cake."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""And the news of a new Toras heir?..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the news of a new Toras heir? The sprinkles on the proverbial sundae."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico's voice dripped with sarcasm."
entries.dialogueText: Rico's voice dripped with sarcasm.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""And the portrait of the Queen Moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the portrait of the Queen Mother? The talk of the night."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""And the portrait of the Queen Moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the portrait of the Queen Mother? So very interesting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded silently in agreement."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded silently in agreement.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A respected monarch knows when to..."
entries.dialogueText: "A respected monarch knows when to keep his private life private. I do wish you had exercised more discretion, Romus."

entries.dialogueText: "The Toras bloodline will end tomorrow if the protest movement gets its way. Tell me, do I have our house's support against the uprising or not?"

entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Valenqiris will fight for the Crow..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valenqiris will fight for the Crown, Your Majesty."

entries.dialogueText: "But only if you promise that you will restore dignity and integrity to the monarchy."

entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean by that?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I cannot restore it if it never went away in the first place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are under attack. Who cares abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are under attack. Who cares about integrity at a time like this?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Romus. Listen to me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our kingdom will not survive unles..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our kingdom will not survive unless you abdicate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why, thank you. Pabel and I couldn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, thank you. Pabel and I couldn't be prouder of how it all turned out."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo exhaled and shook his head sad..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo exhaled and shook his head sadly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know what you think of me and Pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what you think of me and Pabel. But as your monarch and your blood kin, I ask for your acceptance."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Your Majesty... House Toras cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... House Toras cannot affirm this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo exhaled and shook his head sad..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo exhaled and shook his head sadly.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Your Majesty... I cannot let your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... I cannot let your unnatural lifestyle go unremarked upon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're the father of a common crim..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the father of a common criminal, Hugo. You don't get to judge me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. I will be relegated to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. I will be relegated to the back of history books while the dynasty created by Ricardus and Vina lives on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed. I will be relegated to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. I will be relegated to the back of history books while Vina shapes Rizia's future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nonsense. My daughter will return..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. My daughter will return to Rizia, and when she does, she will be my rightful successor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nonsense. My daughter is still a T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. My daughter is still a Toras, even if her name says otherwise."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Outrage flashed across Hugo's face,..."
entries.dialogueText: Outrage flashed across Hugo's face, quickly replaced by a look of resignation.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes... you're right. This is what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... you're right. This is what our once-great house has come to."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""My dear cousin, you must admit tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "My dear cousin, you must admit that between yourself and tonight's guest of honor, this particular branch of our family tree has begun to look rather blighted."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Still, Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "Still, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""A lovely vision, my cousin. Let's..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lovely vision, my cousin. Let's hope it comes to pass."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I couldn't give a damn about the T..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't give a damn about the Toras bloodline. I am concerned with the future of our country, not the future of the throne."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I may no longer rule Valenqiris. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may no longer rule Valenqiris. But I know the people of our province long for dignity and integrity to be restored to the monarchy after two generations of scandal."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Three, if you count Her Highness t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Three, if you count Her Highness the runaway bride."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Three, including Her Highness' ign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Three, including Her Highness' ignominious exit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My mother told me something along..."
entries.dialogueText: "My mother told me something along the same lines. She advised me to abdicate, in fact."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""The people of Valenqiris long for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people of Valenqiris long for dignity and integrity to be restored to the monarchy after two generations of scandal."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Especially in our home province, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially in our home province, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus, the stability and continuit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, the stability and continuity of the monarchy is what ensures the future of the country. They are inextricably intertwined."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. I will. Done.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I will. Done."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Do you understand what that means,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you understand what that means, Romus?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not this again. My mother wants th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not this again. My mother wants the exact same thing."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then Madam Estela is wiser than I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then Madam Estela is wiser than I thought."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your insolence is unbelievable. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your insolence is unbelievable. I will reign until I'm dead."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Your Majesty, the Valenqiris nobil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, the Valenqiris nobility is willing to dedicate their considerable resources toward shutting down the rebellion."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""But only if we can guarantee a ret..."
entries.dialogueText: "But only if we can guarantee a return to the stability of years past. And an end to the past two generations of scandal."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Three, if you count Her Highness t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Three, if you count Her Highness the runaway bride."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Three, including Her Highness' ign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Three, including Her Highness' ignominious exit."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Your uncle speaks the truth.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your uncle speaks the truth."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hubertus. Is that really what you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hubertus. Is that really what you are asking of me?"

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I'm afraid it is.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are taking too dim a view of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are taking too dim a view of the Valenqirians. When called upon, they will rise to defend their King, no matter whom he loves."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""A few will. But not enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "A few will. But not enough."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You don't have to announce it to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to announce it to the public right away. We have a war to win, after all."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You don't have to announce it to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to announce it to the public right away."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But it must happen sooner, rather..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it must happen sooner, rather than later."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I already have House Azaro and Hou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I already have House Azaro and House Sazon on my side. I don't need Valenqiris."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would rather hand over the crown..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would rather hand over the crown to my family than to the revolutionaries. I will do as you ask." [Abdication Promise]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will abdicate. But I'm doing it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will abdicate. But I'm doing it for Mother, not for you." [Abdication Promise]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If preserving the monarchy means p..."
entries.dialogueText: "If preserving the monarchy means preserving a legacy of bigotry, then the revolutionaries deserve to win."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is preposterous. You are my s..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is preposterous. You are my subjects and my blood kin. You must come to my defense unconditionally."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My relatives looked shaken."
entries.dialogueText: My relatives looked shaken.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want the Duchess of Valeniqiris..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want the Duchess of Valeniqiris herself to weigh in on this. Where is Vina?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Right here, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right here, Father."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter approached our group."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter approached our group.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I've heard just enough to know wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard just enough to know what's going on. And I'm staying out of this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina. I am your father and your ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina. I am your father and your king. You will marshall Valenqiris' strength and help Rizia immediately."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you realize that you won't inhe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you realize that you won't inherit the throne if the revolutionaries succeed?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They want me to abdicate, just bec..."
entries.dialogueText: "They want me to abdicate, just because of who I am. Doesn't that strike you as unfair?"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If taking the throne means suppres..."
entries.dialogueText: "If taking the throne means suppressing the voice of the people, then I don't want it anymore."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If Hubertus takes it upon himself..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Hubertus takes it upon himself to do so, I will not get in his way. But I will not act to suppress the voice of the people."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What's unfair is suppressing the v..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's unfair is suppressing the voice of the people when they are crying out for change."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You can fight to your heart's cont..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can fight to your heart's content. But if you ask me, we deserve whatever's coming to us."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""My wife, gentlemen. Talk about a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "My wife, gentlemen. Talk about a royal pain."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Su Omina will be on our side as we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Su Omina will be on our side as well."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank God.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank God."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My relatives sighed in obvious reli..."
entries.dialogueText: My relatives sighed in obvious relief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My relatives exchanged uncomfortabl..."
entries.dialogueText: My relatives exchanged uncomfortable looks.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Forgive me, Your Majesty. I wish w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. I wish we could be of more assistance."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Straight away, Your Grace.""
entries.dialogueText: "Straight away, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'll reach out to the rest of Hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll reach out to the rest of House Toras at once. Hubertus, I'm counting on you to marshall the Valenqiris nobility."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Hubertus, I'm counting on you to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hubertus, I'm counting on you to gather support from House Toras and the Valenqiris nobility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't care what Vina says. I wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't care what Vina says. I will abdicate if it means calming the rebellion and restoring the monarchy." [Abdication Promise]

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you'll excuse me, I'm going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I'm going to get a drink."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned her back swiftly and wal..."
entries.dialogueText: She turned her back swiftly and walked away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and Hubertus gave each other d..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and Hubertus gave each other dubious looks, then turned toward me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will respect Vina's wishes. I fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will respect Vina's wishes. I forbid Valenqiris from entering this fight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My decision is the same. Despite p..."
entries.dialogueText: "My decision is the same. Despite pressure from the revolutionaries and dissent within my own house, I will fight on. Alone, if need be."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What would you all have me do?""
entries.dialogueText: "What would you all have me do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My mother's common birth and my or..."
entries.dialogueText: "My mother's common birth and my orientation are not 'scandals.' They're a part of our identity."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But not House Toras' identity.""
entries.dialogueText: "But not House Toras' identity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and Hubertus looked at each ot..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and Hubertus looked at each other. There was a long silence.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I trust you to do right by our hou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you to do right by our house, Romus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am done talking about this. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am done talking about this. You will accept my relationship with Pabel, or face the consequences."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My relatives looked at each other...."
entries.dialogueText: My relatives looked at each other. There was a long silence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My relatives looked at each other...."
entries.dialogueText: My relatives looked at each other. After a long silence, Hugo nodded.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We will support you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will support you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We will support you, Romus. But yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will support you, Romus. But you'll understand that we can't be happy about it."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Forgive us for stepping out of lin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive us for stepping out of line."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I will do my best to promote toler..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will do my best to promote tolerance in Valenqiris, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Short of handing over the crown, i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Short of handing over the crown, isn't there anything I can do that would redeem me in your eyes?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand what you're saying. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand what you're saying. I will think very carefully about how my actions impact the future of the Rizian throne and the reputation of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Long live the kings.""
entries.dialogueText: "Long live the kings."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico bowed a little too deeply."
entries.dialogueText: Rico bowed a little too deeply.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Rizian monarchy needs to enter..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian monarchy needs to enter the modern age. This revelation is only the beginning."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus raised his eyebrows."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus raised his eyebrows.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""The beginning of what?""
entries.dialogueText: "The beginning of what?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't have much time to waste, g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have much time to waste, gentlemen. I want to know whether I can count on Valenqiris' support against the current unrest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've heard news of protests in Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've heard news of protests in Valenqiris. What's going on?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My cousin bowed his head."
entries.dialogueText: My cousin bowed his head.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Why, Your Majesty. You can always..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, Your Majesty. You can always count on the nobility of our province to assist the crown in whatever way it can."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Please do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please do."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""However, due to the crippling taxe..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, due to the crippling taxes they now have to pay on their estates, I cannot guarantee that they will be of much use in this fight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded in confirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded in confirmation.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I would humbly ask you to repeal t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would humbly ask you to repeal that tax, ensuring future prosperity for Valenqiris landowners."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's all you want? It's a deal.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's all you want? It's a deal."
entries.menuText: "That's all you want? It's a deal." [Revert Landowner Tax Decree]

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, I can't just snap my finger..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, I can't just snap my fingers and release him. There are procedures to be followed, you know."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He's your cousin, Romus. My only s..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's your cousin, Romus. My only son."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But I've been hearing calls for hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I've been hearing calls for his release since he was proven innocent in the Wehlen affair."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm no great admirer of Cousin Ric..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm no great admirer of Cousin Rico, myself."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But he does command a following in..."
entries.dialogueText: "But he does command a following in Valenqiris."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regardless, my answer is still no.""
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, my answer is still no."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Vina sighed.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Thank you, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Father."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I am only doing what my King comma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am only doing what my King commands, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If you'll excuse me, I'm going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I'm going to check in on Grandmother. The last time I saw her, she was on her third martini."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Which means by now, she's on the f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which means by now, she's on the floor."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina looked uneasily at Hubertus an..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina looked uneasily at Hubertus and Hugo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus laughed."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus laughed.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's not very popular, to say the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not very popular, to say the least."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""It's not very popular, to say the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not very popular, to say the least."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""The RPP has held rallies in the ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RPP has held rallies in the major cities, but attendance has been low."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""The RPP has held rallies in some o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RPP has held rallies in some of the major cities. Attendance was pitiful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even a few supporters can make a b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even a few supporters can make a big impact. In time, the whole of the province will be swayed."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Though I wonder if commoners are b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though I wonder if commoners are being pressured into staying home."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew the threat of reform was ov..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew the threat of reform was overblown. A handful of voices making a big ado about nothing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, we shouldn't underestimate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, we shouldn't underestimate the reformists' reach. I hope you're keeping close watch on things."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""You say that as if it were a good..."
entries.dialogueText: "You say that as if it were a good thing, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A small flame can still spread if..."
entries.dialogueText: "A small flame can still spread if carefully tended. The provincial leadership must monitor these protests closely."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Agreed. A small flame can still sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. A small flame can still spread if carefully tended."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've got to go talk to my other gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've got to go talk to my other guests. But thank you for your feedback."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Of course, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Father."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Anytime, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anytime, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I left my relatives and surveyed th..."
entries.dialogueText: I left my relatives and surveyed the rest of the room.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For your grandmother, that's a lig..."
entries.dialogueText: "For your grandmother, that's a light aperitif."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such vices can no longer be tolera..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such vices can no longer be tolerated in the new Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Already? I've got some catching up..."
entries.dialogueText: "Already? I've got some catching up to do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina curtsied and left."
entries.dialogueText: Vina curtsied and left.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm not going to be the one to tel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to be the one to tell her that."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""She's 75 years old. She can't keep..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's 75 years old. She can't keep up her old habits forever."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""It's her night, Father.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's her night, Father."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Wait, Romus. One last thing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait, Romus. One last thing."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I thank you nonetheless for your w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank you nonetheless for your willingness to hear our request, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""They'll be thrilled to hear this i..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll be thrilled to hear this in Monqiz."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Don't despair, Hugo. The King will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't despair, Hugo. The King will forgive Rico in time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina cleared her throat."
entries.dialogueText: Vina cleared her throat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My daughter smiled reluctantly."
entries.dialogueText: My daughter smiled reluctantly.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Yes, it's a boon to the province.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it's a boon to the province."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Queen Mother will be fine. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Queen Mother will be fine. You don't need to babysit her."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Very good, Your Majesty. I hope th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, Your Majesty. I hope the rest of your evening is thenthational."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico bit his tongue."
entries.dialogueText: Rico bit his tongue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked across the room at Lucita..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked across the room at Lucita and the other Azaros.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Until next time, Cousin.""
entries.dialogueText: "Until next time, Cousin."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Enjoy the gathering. Who knows the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enjoy the gathering. Who knows the next time all of us will be together again?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You and Queen Consort Lucita have..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and Queen Consort Lucita have my sincerest congratulations."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And I must say, I hope the new hei..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I must say, I hope the new heir is a boy. It would give me great relief to know that House Toras will keep the throne for another generation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And I must say, I hope the new hei..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I must say, I hope the new heir is a boy. It would lighten the heartache of Vina's absence to know that House Toras will keep the throne for another generation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If your new heir is a boy, you wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your new heir is a boy, you will have a difficult decision ahead of you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I hope that you will remember all..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope that you will remember all of the reasons I advocated for the marriage between my son and your daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I too am praying we'll be ble..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I too am praying we'll be blessed with a son."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina has wanted to be Queen since..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina has wanted to be Queen since she was a little girl. I don't want to break her heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, well, we'll see about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, well, we'll see about that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope so too. I've always wanted..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope so too. I've always wanted a son."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I hope you will choose wisely.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you will choose wisely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No matter what happens, House Tora..."
entries.dialogueText: "No matter what happens, House Toras will hold the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It strikes me as unfair that Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: "It strikes me as unfair that Vina would lose her inheritance simply for the crime of being born female."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It is royal tradition, Romus. Fair..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is royal tradition, Romus. Fairness doesn't matter."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It is royal tradition, Romus. She..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is royal tradition, Romus. She must understand that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have already promised House Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have already promised House Azaro this. Lucita's prince will be Rizia's future king."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I only pray that the rest of the A..."
entries.dialogueText: "I only pray that the rest of the Azaros will still know their place."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You will have to watch the other A..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will have to watch the other Azaros closely, though. A claim to the throne will embolden them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We've stayed in power for this lon..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've stayed in power for this long. Fate will smile upon us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Any son of mine will be Rizia's fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any son of mine will be Rizia's future king. I promised this to the Azaros already."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Any son of mine will be Rizia's fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any son of mine will be Rizia's future king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina has wanted to be queen since..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina has wanted to be queen since she was a little girl. I won't take that away from her."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes, thank God for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, thank God for that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo gave a nod of understanding."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo gave a nod of understanding.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then for the sake of our house, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then for the sake of our house, I hope you'll have a daughter."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Azaros have been our allies fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros have been our allies for a long time. But you should be wary of granting them so much power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It strikes me as unfair that Vina..."
entries.dialogueText: "It strikes me as unfair that Vina would lose her inheritance simply for the crime of being born female."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It is royal tradition, Romus. Fair..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is royal tradition, Romus. Fairness doesn't matter. But exceptions are not unheard of."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico was scowling."
entries.dialogueText: Rico was scowling.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Come on, Father. You've talked His..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Father. You've talked His Majesty's ear off for long enough."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus was frowning."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus was frowning.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Come, Your Grace. His Majesty has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come, Your Grace. His Majesty has many other people to talk to tonight."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""It hasn't been easy, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It hasn't been easy, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I confess I almost didn't join for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I confess I almost didn't join for tonight's celebrations, so nervous was I about leaving my palace."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I practically had to drag Cousin H..."
entries.dialogueText: "I practically had to drag Cousin Hubertus here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus looked down in shame."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus looked down in shame.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I know the officials are doing the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know the officials are doing their best, but the revolutionaries... there's just too many of them."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Their ingratitude is unbelievable,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their ingratitude is unbelievable, Your Majesty. After all the Crown has given them."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""They were given everything except..."
entries.dialogueText: "They were given everything except for what they truly wanted. Freedom."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""All of Su Omina's efforts have bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "All of Su Omina's efforts have been useless against these barbarians."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""We should have known that using fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should have known that using force would never work."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I still can't believe you arrested..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still can't believe you arrested their leader, Father."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""They are content, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "They are content, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I was hoping they'd quiet down wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was hoping they'd quiet down with their leader out of the picture. Alas, the opposite seems to be happening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let them throw their tantrum. They..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let them throw their tantrum. They will quiet down in due time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I take the nobility's peace of min..."
entries.dialogueText: "I take the nobility's peace of mind seriously. Tell your constituents their King will protect them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am counting on you and the rest..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am counting on you and the rest of the other provincial leadership to preserve order."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've tried everything I possibly c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've tried everything I possibly could. I'm afraid it's out of my hands now."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Very comforting, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very comforting, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Time was that the Rizian people tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time was that the Rizian people trusted House Toras to provide for them. We've failed them for the last time."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You and Cousin Hubertus can 'prese..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and Cousin Hubertus can 'preserve order' to your heart's content. But I won't play a part in it."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""We will try our best, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will try our best, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""This is more than just a tantrum.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is more than just a tantrum."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I trust you are right.""
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you are right."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""And the ordinary people crying out..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the ordinary people crying out to be heard? What do I tell them?"

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I most certainly will, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "I most certainly will, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I am doing what I can to keep our..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am doing what I can to keep our province together, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hubertus, Hugo... are you with me,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hubertus, Hugo... are you with me, at least?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rico, can you talk some sense into..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rico, can you talk some sense into your wife?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I wish I could, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am doing more for the Rizian peo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am doing more for the Rizian people than you know. Someday, they will thank me."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Always, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Always, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Valenqiris will stand as a bastion..."
entries.dialogueText: "Valenqiris will stand as a bastion of royal values. Until the very end."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded in affirmation."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded in affirmation.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""The rest of Valenqiris may be wave..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rest of Valenqiris may be wavering in its support for the Crown. But I am still on your side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and Hubertus exchanged wary gl..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and Hubertus exchanged wary glances.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've brought God into their lives..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've brought God into their lives. How can you say we've failed them?"

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Your great efforts on behalf of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your great efforts on behalf of the Wruhecist community have not gone unseen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have failed no one. I command yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have failed no one. I command you to do your duty as Duchess and take a stand against what's happening."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina looked as if she was going to..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina looked as if she was going to be sick.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""I'm going to get a drink.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to get a drink."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She walked away with quick steps."
entries.dialogueText: She walked away with quick steps.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Nothing is more important to this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing is more important to this house. To me."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My final answer is no. Sorry to di..."
entries.dialogueText: "My final answer is no. Sorry to disappoint you."
